checks.scope: Exact numeric bits, sparse occupancy, unequal dimensions, all six axis permutations, all axis selection orders, split/reencode/recompose; no engine or security suite.

protocol: Python structural prototype calling existing native SQLNEW codecs. Full packets include headers, sparse occupancy, region directories, edge biases and compressed payloads. Read counters count distinct encoded records and unique decoded leaves with a fresh per-query cache; they are logical work, not physical disk I/O or native latency.

source_byte_control.description: Sorted codec Python source files concatenated, capped at 2 MiB and truncated to whole 64-bit words. Arbitrary z,y,x layout; this is source text, not extracted document evidence.
